bestNextCodexPrompt.block: W88: Real User Test Packet And Exact Test Instructions
bestNextCodexPrompt.prompt: Move through W88: Real User Test Packet And Exact Test Instructions. Convert the W87 dry-run results into the exact hands-on test packet for the user: provide the specific file/version to load, the exact sales request fields to enter, the tabs/screenshots to capture, the DCC handoff JSON and trace JSON exports to attach, the operator comparison steps, scoring rubric, and stop/go decision. Preserve no IDB writes, no DCC runner rewrite, no transaction writes, hosted resolver optional until remoteSmokeExecuted=true, consultant confirmation required, and DCC ownership of object generation. Output the real user test packet, exact test instructions, evidence intake checklist, W88 report, validator gates, and best next Codex prompt.
